title: The DOM: Your Page as a Tree

blocks.content: Course: Make Your Website Interactive with JavaScript
The DOM: Your Page as a Tree
Remember how the browser reads your page from top to bottom?
When it finishes, it does not just display it. It turns your entire HTML into a living structure that JavaScript can reach into and change. That structure is called the DOM.

blocks.alt: The DOM as a tree structure

blocks.content: Every time you change text, add a class, or hide something, you are changing the DOM.
And the rule is always the same:

The text changes the moment the page loads. No click. No interaction. Just JavaScript reaching into the DOM and updating it directly.
You selected the element. You updated it. That's the DOM at work.
